info.title: Compte Kete API
info.description: One account for every Kete app. `/api/auth` is the identity (@kete/identity, Better Auth): people, organizations, passkeys, second factor, and the OpenID provider every Kete app signs in with. `/api/apps` serves trusted Kete apps, `/api/admin` Kete Cockpit.

tags.name: Default
tags.description: Default endpoints that are included with Better Auth by default. These endpoints are not part of any plugin.

tags.name: Apps
tags.description: Trusted Kete apps, with their own token (spec 013, 014).
